_about: Model-writer arm of writer_ablation_bench.py. Captured 2026-11-08: one fresh Claude subagent per session (8 total), each given ONLY writer_prompt(session) (the transcript + Rainman's `remember` tool contract), no tools, never the probes. Answers are recorded verbatim. One run, no variance estimate.

s1.content: Parallel invoice creation returned 500s with IntegrityError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "invoices_number_key". Root cause: allocate_number() in src/invoices/numbering.py computed SELECT MAX(Invoice.number)+1, so two concurrent requests could get the same number. Fix: allocate_number() now returns next_invoice_seq(session), which draws from the Postgres sequence invoice_number_seq and is atomic. Verified by tests/test_invoices.py::test_parallel_create (all 15 invoice tests pass). Rule: never allocate invoice numbers, or any other unique sequential ID, with MAX+1. Use the Postgres sequence.

s2.content: tests/test_webhooks.py::test_retry_delivery failing with 'TimeoutError: delivery did not complete within 10s' is not flakiness or a product bug. The test runs three backoff rounds, which take about 35s on CI runners, but pytest.ini set TIDE_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT=10. Fix: raised TIDE_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT to 45 in the pytest.ini env section, and all 9 webhook tests now pass (about 41s). If the retry/backoff schedule grows, raise this timeout above the total backoff time.

s3.content: All monetary amounts in Tidewater are integers in MILLICENTS (1/1000 of a cent), so FX conversion never rounds. Never divide by 100 to get a display value; that is off by 1000x. To format money, call src.money.to_display(amount, currency), which divides by 100_000. Email invoice totals already go through src/emails/format.py format_invoice_total(), which wraps to_display.

s4.content: Decision: all PDF rendering runs on the isolated `bulkhead` queue (isolated workers, concurrency 2), not the shared `default` Celery queue. Reason: PDF rendering was blocking API workers, and on `default` a burst of PDFs would starve invoice emails. render_invoice_pdf in src/pdf/render.py now uses @task(queue="bulkhead"). Any new PDF-rendering task should also set queue="bulkhead".

s5.content: File exports (CSV and similar) are never built inline in the public API. The API endpoint only enqueues a job with the quarry service (services/quarry) and returns the job id, because building large tenants' files inline times out. Example: POST /transactions/export in src/api/transactions.py returns {'job_id': quarry.enqueue_export('transactions', req.tenant)}. The rule is documented in src/exports/README.md.

s6.content: Do not modify anything under src/legacy/. The Finance team owns it. If a change is needed there, ask in #fin-platform instead of editing the code.

The customers.cust_id column was renamed to customer_id (src/models/customer.py, migration migrations/0042_rename_customer_id.py). src/legacy/billing_v1.py still reads row.cust_id through its own mapper and was left unchanged because Finance owns it. If legacy billing breaks on the old column name, raise it in #fin-platform rather than patching it.
